title: Token Approvals: The Hidden Wallet Permission Beginners Forget to Check
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. A token approval lets a smart contract move your tokens, and old unlimited approvals can stay active until you revoke them. Sources: Trust Wallet, Coinbase, Etherscan. AI-generated voice. Educational only. Not financial advice.

scenes.head: HIDDEN PERMISSION
scenes.narration: Did you know your crypto wallet may still be giving old apps permission to move your tokens?

scenes.head: WHAT IT IS
scenes.narration: A token approval lets a smart contract move a specific token from your wallet, and you usually grant it only once.

scenes.head: THE CATCH
scenes.narration: Many apps ask for unlimited access by default, and the approval stays active even after you disconnect.

scenes.head: THE RISK
scenes.narration: If that contract is hacked, or you approved a fake site, scammers may use the permission to drain tokens.

scenes.head: CHECK YOUR LIST
items: Revoke ones you do not use
scenes.narration: Review your approvals regularly, revoke the ones you no longer use, and prefer a set limit over unlimited access.

scenes.head: HOW TO REVIEW
scenes.narration: Trusted checker tools, like Etherscan's approval checker, let you review and revoke. Revoking usually costs a small gas fee.

scenes.head: EDUCATION, NOT ADVICE
scenes.narration: Never sign something you do not understand. This is education, not advice.
